title: Finite affine refinement of a pro-etale cover
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and assume $S$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $\{W_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of the small pro-étale site [sk-def-pe-site], and let $S=\bigcup_{\alpha=1}^t U_\alpha$ be a finite affine open cover [def-pc-scheme]. For each $\alpha$ there exist finitely many indices $i(\alpha,j)$ and affine opens $V_{\alpha j}\subset W_{i(\alpha,j)}\times_S U_\alpha$ whose images cover $U_\alpha$. The finite family $\{V_{\alpha j}\to S\}$ is itself a covering family of $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$: each map is weakly étale [sk-def-pe-morphisms], and the finite affine-refinement condition of [sk-def-pe-site] holds over every affine open of $S$.
